venue: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium, Gainesville FL
title: Week 1 vs FAU
dek: They run Baugh. The line is how Faulkner keeps you from sitting on that. Pullers one way. Interior the other. You cannot tell which is the lie.
watchNote: PROVISIONAL — first drives sat with Charles. Later snaps sat off the condensed cut and scoring clips for the line. Fan rail stays empty.
headline: The snap you caught is the family. Tackles sell counter. The interior three leave. The ball goes with the three — or the pull is real and Baugh punches it.

offense.body:
They run Baugh. The line is how Faulkner keeps you from sitting on that.

The snap you caught is the family. Tackles pull like it is counter. The interior three release the other way. Brown is in motion, four yards deep. The ball goes to Brown — to the three, not to the pullers. FAU stepped with the pullers. That is the design.

He does not run that once. Later in the half the same split shows up again. Pullers one way. Three big people out in the flat the other way. Philo sells the first look. On Clark’s 10-yard score the interior is down the field on the boundary after they throw it to the back. Same idea. Get the big people out in front of a skill player.

When they want the punch, the pull is real. Baugh’s 12-yard score: the pullers lead and he hits it. Opening drive, the line washes one way and he cuts the other hole. That is still the same first step. You cannot tell if the pull is the lie or the truth until the ball comes out.

When they need a yard, nobody leaves. Fourth-and-1 sneak. Philo from the 3. The line stays home and they push.

Abrams 63 is the other answer. They crowd the run. The line is in a pass set. He throws it over the top. Wilson is the chain mover when they dress the run and throw the sit — 19, then 15, then 13. Stockton from 12. Brown is not a gadget: the screen, the 49, the 14 as the runner, the 33, the 18. The 61 is the run when the whole stadium knows. The line just wins.

Pistol was one look in the opening script. The night is the line lying, then telling the truth, then staying home.

What to clean: the keep when Sledge crashes and is still there — that pull lost. The snap that loses twenty inside the five. The ball that comes off Mays. Those are real. They are not the night.
bullets: The family: tackles sell counter, interior three leave. Ball goes with the three — Brown, later Clark.
Same first step, other answer: the pull is real and Baugh punches it. 12-yard score. Wash-and-cut on the opening drive.
When they need a yard, nobody leaves. Sneak. Philo from the 3.
Abrams 63 is the pass set when they crowd the run. Clean the Sledge keep, the snap, and the ball off Mays.

defense.body:
White mixes the odd front. Woods is the lever.

He will play a 3-3-5. Three down. JACK as a stand-up. Two linebackers. Five DBs. Then he will space the tackles, stand both edges up, and run a stunt. Then he will shade three down linemen to one side and put Woods and a linebacker in the other gap. He changes the look often enough that the line cannot get a clean count. Not every snap. Often.

On third down he moves Woods. On the ball, Woods is the edge. Off the ball, the edge belongs to somebody else and Woods is coming or dropping from a different spot. That is how you put the rusher in a better lane without telling the tackle who has him. Third-and-7: Woods in a backer, press, comeback to Henry, they convert. Third-and-1: Woods off, nickel on the line, corners off, hitch to Valsin, they convert. Later Woods is in the run fit — Ervin, Farrow — when they try to stay on schedule.

The coverage mixes with the front. Early down: one-high, corners off, Chiles fills the short middle, three yards, they win the snap. Next snap: same family, wide stunt, Valsin converts — the hitch is the tax. Third-and-10: shade front, press one side, off the other. Coleman opens to the middle, sells the hole, the ball goes outside, Coleman is already back to the receiver. That is the pick. Not a blitz they needed. He moved the quarterback’s eyes. Johnson’s pick is the same family.

FAU lived on the hitch, the comeback, and the sit — five to eight yards at a time. White plays off a lot. When the stunt does not get home, that throw is there. That is ninety snaps.

What looked good: Coleman’s bait. Johnson’s pick. Bett stripping the keep at the 1. McCloud taking fourth-and-2. James stopping Ervin to end the half. Chiles on the short middle. Lyons and Flowers in the backfield. Woods when he is asked to tackle.

What leaked: Henry and Valsin taking what was given. The pile at the 1. The edge leaving and Veltkamp walking in. The fade when the corner is off. Hoch on fourth down. Sit on the hitch. Keep the edge when the quarterback keeps it.
bullets: 3-3-5, spaced, shaded — he mixes the odd front. Woods is the lever on third down.
Coleman sells middle, takes outside. Johnson’s pick is the same family.
They play off a lot. The hitch is the tax. Ninety snaps.
Clean the pile, the edge, the fade, Hoch on fourth. Sit on the hitch.

specials.body: The drive stalls. They take the points. Durkin from 53. Florida never punts. FAU’s 18-yard punt is how the second Florida score starts.
bullets: FAU’s 18-yard punt sets up the short field.

keys: Baugh is the night. The line is how they keep you from sitting on him.
Pullers one way, interior the other. You cannot tell if it is the lie or the punch.
When they need a yard, nobody leaves.
White mixes the 3-3-5. Woods is the lever on third down. The hitch is the tax.

nextWeek.look: They will throw it short and keep it. Florida will still run Baugh and dress the line — pullers one way, interior the other. White has to sit on the hitch and keep Woods’ edge home when the quarterback pulls it.
